The dispatch's finding (A-205, measured 2026-09-17) is that the route `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts` returned `payload.geojson.features[].properties.buildableAreaSqFt` / `buildableAreaPct` on EVERY drawn envelope, and `apps/property-explorer/api/spine.ts` allowlists that POST path for anonymous callers, so the refused figure reached anyone through smartsite.cloud while the panel (`figureWithheld`) and the MCP draw block (`derivedFigures.denies`) withheld it on their own. REPRODUCED LIVE the day of the change: anonymous POST, 629 Sturgeon Dr, San Marcos TX 78666 (parcel 48209:97658), HTTP 200, `derivePath` = 'labelEdges+derive' with NO '+atom-reconciled' segment, `buildableAreaSqFt` 5022, `buildableAreaPct` 58.3. The route was the one surface that did not withhold.
completionPredicate: An anonymous POST to the deployed surface for an UNVERIFIED parcel returns a drawn envelope whose `payload.geojson.features[0].properties` contains NEITHER `buildableAreaSqFt` NOR `buildableAreaPct` (key absent, not 0 and not null), and the paired ENTITLED parcel on the same request still carries both numbers (19052 / 63.5 at the pre-deploy read, `derivePath` ending '+atom-reconciled'). Both legs must be run and must DIVERGE: a blanket strip that withholds from both FAILS, because it takes the figure away from a verified parcel. Exact requests and a one-line verdict are in `_inbox/2026-09-17_p304-area-figure_live-probe.md`; the integration seat grades it after deploying PR #713. A stranger can evaluate this with curl and two addresses, without reading any of this lane's code.
scopeBasis: Narrow by design in four places. (1) The withholding is implemented as ABSENCE of the two named properties, not as a zero and not as a substitute figure: a zero would be a DIFFERENT false claim ('setbacks consume the lot'), and re-deriving a number on the way out would mint a new unfounded figure. (2) The verification predicate itself is NOT touched: `isEnvelopeAtomVerified` is imported and called exactly as P-249 left it, because the dispatch forbids changing it and because four readers of the depth-warm field exist in three repos (the A-183 trap) - this lane pins its own agreement with that rule by test rather than re-implementing it. (3) `maxFootprintSqFt` is the SAME withheld number under a third name and is deliberately NOT closed: it is not one of the two fields the dispatch names, and which regime a parcel is in (modelled envelope binds vs codified lot-coverage cap binds) is an entitlement RULING, i.e. an operator stop point - so it is reported with its numbers and a one-line remedy instead of being widened unilaterally (see leave_behind). (4) hauska-engine's own PDF/site-plan figure is an independent computation (P-261, different repo and seat) and is out of scope; a read-only grep of P:/hauska-engine for the two field names found 40+ hits, ALL inside engine-core's own model/scripts/tests, so this route's properties are not an input to it.
falsifier: PROVEN for all three dispatch falsifiers, and the third by REVERTING THE FIX rather than by assertion. (1) After the change the route response for an unverified fixture contains NEITHER property - asserted at the WIRE in `artifacts/api-server/src/__tests__/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.test.ts`, block 'P-304 area figure withholding' case (a): `'buildableAreaSqFt' in props === false` and `'buildableAreaPct' in props === false`, PLUS a `not.toContain('7777')` guard that the unverified atom's own number is not quoted in their place, PLUS the positive halves (status 'ok', geometry present, disclosure names the withholding, `parcelAreaSqFt` survives) so the case cannot pass by returning nothing - and asserted again at the composition in `composeBuildableEnvelopeDerivation.test.ts` as KEY ABSENCE (the withheld shape, explicitly not 0). (2) A verified fixture still carries them - case (b) at the wire (depth-warm promotion marker + atom outcome area 7777 -> served 7777, `derivePath` 'labelEdges+derive+atom-reconciled', no withholding disclosure) and the composition-level verified case (99_999). (3) Reverting the change fails a test - `git stash push` of the three SOURCE files only, tests left in the tree, `npx vitest run -t "P-304" src/__tests__/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.test.ts` -> literal 'Tests 1 failed | 1 passed | 22 skipped (24)', with '(a) anonymous POST to an UNVERIFIED parcel' FAILING at its first assertion (expected true to be false: the production-shaped behaviour still serves the figure) while '(b) verified-atom fixture' PASSES - the pair discriminates on the fix, not on the fixture. Restored with `git stash pop`; working tree clean afterwards. Full log: `_inbox/2026-09-17_p304-area-figure_falsifier3-stash.log`. BEYOND the dispatch's three, the predicate's NEAR-MISSES are pinned as a non-vacuous scoping test: a version-shifted marker ('depth-warm-promoted-v2') and a near-miss citation ('depth-warm-verify') must stay WITHHELD, while the documented 'depth-warm-verified' citation fallback must PRINT. What is NOT proven is named rather than implied: NOTHING here observes a DEPLOYED surface, which is why the status is closed-partial.
contradicted: NOTHING contradicts the ruling, the fix or the dispatch's diagnosis. The leak was exactly where the dispatch said, and the live reproduction matched the dispatch's own numbers for the same parcel (Hays 48209:97658: 5022 and 58.3, from an unverified atom). Three things are CORRECTED or NARROWED in this record rather than silently absorbed, and one is reported as a finding. (1) The dispatch's shelf statement that the withheld figure is the two named properties is incomplete: `maxFootprintSqFt` carries the same number on an unverified parcel (5022 alongside the withheld 5022), and `derive.ts:286-292` shows why - `maxFootprintSqFt = round(min(buildableAreaSqFt, coverageCap))`, i.e. it IS the modelled buildable area whenever the modelled envelope is the binding constraint, a third name for the same withheld figure. It is NOT closed here (not dispatched, and not purely modelled: when the coverage cap binds it falls out of two authoritative numbers alone and is legitimately printable), so it is reported. (2) The dispatch's 'What to build 2' asks for the consumer list including the PDF and site plan in hauska-engine; read at source, the engine computes and carries its OWN figure and never consumes this route's properties, so the PDF is unaffected by this change and its entitlement gap is a sibling (P-261), not a consumer.
